briefing: Markets were quietly mixed today with NASDAQ down 0.4% and the S&P 500 down 0.1% — no clear risk-on or risk-off signal. Cash sits at $389.29, below the $500 deployment threshold, so per strategy memory we're holding rather than forcing a buy into a neutral tape, letting the existing 7 positions run.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears rather than being spent just because it's available. Today the portfolio's cash balance was below the buy threshold anyway, but the underlying discipline is the same: patient investors wait for confirmed signals instead of forcing trades on quiet, directionless days.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指投資人保留在場邊的現金，等待真正有力的機會出現時才動用，而不是因為手上有錢就隨意買進。今日現金餘額本就低於買入門檻，但背後的紀律是一樣的：有耐心的投資人會等待明確訊號確認，而不是在方向不明的平淡交易日中勉強進場。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted slightly lower today, with the NASDAQ underperforming the S&P 500, suggesting mild profit-taking in growth-oriented names rather than any broad selloff. The moves were small enough (under 0.5%) to be consistent with normal daily noise rather than a shift in market direction. Without a strong catalyst in either direction, this reads as a consolidation day.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日兩大指數皆小幅走弱，納斯達克跌幅略高於標普500指數，顯示成長股出現溫和獲利了結，而非全面性拋售。指數波動幅度均在0.5%以內，屬於正常的日內波動範圍，並非市場方向轉變的訊號。在缺乏明確催化劑的情況下，今日可視為整理格局。
